commits.author: xl-openai
commits.message: Use server app auth requirements for remote plugin install

notes: Built from GitHub pull-request, commits, files, and repo endpoints.

primary_pr.body:
## Summary
- request `includeAppsNeedingAuth=true` when installing remote plugins
- return backend-provided `app_ids_needing_auth` from the remote install client
- use those app IDs to populate `appsNeedingAuth` without refetching accessible apps, with fallback for older responses

## Testing
- `just fmt`
- `just test -p codex-app-server`
- `just test -p codex-core-plugins`
- real app-server install/uninstall check with Notion remote plugin
- subagent review found no blocking issues
primary_pr.title: Use server app auth requirements for remote plugin install
